title: How to Find Your GoPay QRIS Code Quickly
summary: Wondering how to find your GoPay QRIS code? This simple guide walks you through every method so you can share or use your code in seconds.
body_markdown:
[Banking](https://blog.transfez.com/en/banking/)


Picture this: you are at a warung, a friend wants to split the bill, and they ask, “Hey, what is your GoPay QRIS code?” You open the app, tap around aimlessly, and suddenly feel like you are lost in a digital maze. Sound familiar? You are definitely not alone. A lot of GoPay users, even regular ones, are not sure exactly where their personal QRIS code lives inside the app. If you have ever wondered **how to find your GoPay QRIS code** , this guide is going to sort that out for you, once and for all.


Whether you want to receive payments from friends, collect money from customers, or simply keep your QR code ready for quick scans, knowing where to look is the first step. And just like learning[how to transfer between digital wallets in Indonesia](https://blog.transfez.com/en/how-to-transfer-from-dana-to-ovo-digital-wallet-indonesia/) , once you know the trick, it takes only a few seconds every time.

##


**What Is a GoPay QRIS Code, Exactly?**


*QRIS* stands for *Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard* , a unified QR payment standard introduced by Bank Indonesia. Your GoPay QRIS code is essentially your personal payment address in QR form. Anyone with a compatible app can scan it and send money straight to your GoPay balance. No bank account number needed, no manual input, just a scan and done.


###


**1. Who Can Use a GoPay QRIS Code?**


Both personal GoPay users and GoPay for Business (merchant) accounts have a QRIS code. If you are a regular user, you can use yours to receive money from friends or family. If you run a small business, your merchant QRIS is what customers scan when they pay you.


###


**2. Is It the Same as a GoPay QR Code?**


Technically, GoPay has always had its own in-app QR code. The *QRIS* version is the standardized, interoperable one, meaning people using other apps like OVO, Dana, ShopeePay, or even their bank apps can scan it and the payment still goes through. It is the more universal option, and it is the one you will want to use most of the time.


##


**How to Find Your GoPay QRIS Code Step by Step**


Good news: your GoPay QRIS code is not hidden deep in some settings menu. It is right on the surface once you know where to tap. Here are the main methods to access it.


###


**1. Find It from the GoPay Home Screen**


1. Open the **Gojek app** on your smartphone.
2. On the home screen, look for the **GoPay** section, usually near the top of the page.
3. Tap on your **GoPay balance** to go into the GoPay wallet screen.
4. You will see a **QR code icon** or a button labeled *Terima* (Receive) or sometimes *My QR* .
5. Tap it, and your personal QRIS code will appear on screen, ready to be scanned.


That is it. Five taps and you are there. The QR code displayed is your personal GoPay QRIS code that others can scan using any QRIS-compatible app.


###


**2. Use the Scan and Pay Section**


1. From the Gojek home screen, tap the **scan icon** (looks like a small QR grid, usually at the top of the screen).
2. Once the scanner opens, look for a tab or toggle that says **My QR** or *Kode QR Saya* .
3. Switch to that tab, and your QRIS code will display.


This method is great when you are already in scanning mode but need to flip it around so someone else can scan you instead.


###


**3. Access It from Your GoPay Profile or Account Details**


1. In the Gojek app, tap your **profile icon** (top left or top right, depending on your version).
2. Navigate to **GoPay settings** or **account details** .
3. Look for a *QR Code* or *QRIS* option.
4. Tap it to view your code.


This path is useful if you want to save or screenshot your code for future sharing, for example sending it over WhatsApp so someone can pay you later.


##


**How to Save and Share Your GoPay QRIS Code**


Once your QRIS code is on screen, you are not limited to letting people scan it live. You can save it and share it digitally, which is perfect for small business owners or freelancers who want to display their code on social media or in a digital invoice.


###


**1. Screenshot or Download Your QRIS Code**


When your QRIS code is on screen, look for a **Save** or **Download** button. Many versions of the app let you save the QR directly to your photo gallery. If not, a quick screenshot works just as well. From there, you can share it via chat, email, or print it out for a physical display at your stall or workspace.


###


**2. Share It Directly from the App**


Some GoPay versions have a **Share** button right next to the QR display. Tapping it lets you send your code instantly through WhatsApp, Instagram, or any other app on your phone. Super convenient for freelancers or anyone selling things online.


##


**Tips for Using Your GoPay QRIS Code Smoothly**


###


**1. Make Sure Your Screen Brightness Is High**


Scanners can struggle in dim lighting or with a low-brightness screen. Before someone scans your code, crank up your screen brightness. It makes the process faster and less awkward for everyone.


###


**2. Keep Your App Updated**


The Gojek app gets updated frequently. If you cannot find the QRIS option where this guide describes, check if your app needs an update. An outdated version might have a different layout or missing features.


###


**3. Verify the Payment Was Received**


After someone scans and pays, you should get an in-app notification and your balance should update almost instantly. Always check before handing over goods or confirming a transaction is done.


###


**4. One Code, Multiple Senders**


Your QRIS code does not change after each use. It is a permanent code tied to your account, so you can share it as many times as you like without generating a new one each time. Think of it like your digital payment address.


##


**What If Your GoPay QRIS Code Is Not Showing?**


Occasionally, the QRIS feature might not appear for your account. This can happen if your GoPay account is not fully verified. Make sure you have completed the identity verification steps inside the app, including uploading your KTP if required. Unverified accounts may have limited features, and QRIS access is sometimes one of them.


If everything looks verified and the feature is still missing, try logging out and back in, clearing the app cache, or reinstalling the app. If none of that helps, reaching out to GoPay customer support through the in-app help center is your best bet.
